audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 given to Gwen and First item given to Skill.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen; the prose itself says 'At level 1 you are both soft' and calls Riftmaker 'your hardest tank-shredding window'.
audit.corrected: Level 1 to Skill, First item to Gwen, in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text and no Sion ability was named anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Packet flags 'never names any of Sion's abilities'. His spikes are a charged Decimating Smash and Unstoppable Onslaught; Gwen's is Riftmaker into his armour stack.
audit.corrected: Decimating Smash, Roar of the Slayer, Soul Furnace, Glory in Death and Unstoppable Onslaught now named with cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page twice says Sion's E shreds your MAGIC RESIST. It does not.
audit.why: Riot on Roar of the Slayer: 'a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit'. It cuts armour, and the poke is physical — so the correct lane answer is Doran's Shield and Second Wind, not MR, and the shred does nothing to Gwen's own magic damage. Also: Decimating Smash only knocks up and stuns 'if he charges for enough time' — a tap-cast neither stuns nor knocks up. And Glory in Death makes a dead Sion's attacks 'deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health' while healing him, so the corpse is not free damage.
audit.corrected: Armour-not-MR corrected in both layers; the charge condition and Glory in Death written in.

audit.why: Decimating Smash 10/9/8/7/6s, Roar of the Slayer 12/11/10/9/8s, Soul Furnace 15-11s with a 3-second reactivation.
audit.corrected: All written into the cooldown block and trading rules.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Sion contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both weak at 1. Decimating Smash only knocks up if he holds the charge — sidestep the wind-up and a tap-cast is nearly harmless.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Sion's Decimating Smash is down.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash opens the window. Decimating Smash is 10s at rank 1 — trade in the gap right after he releases it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Sion must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online. Snip Snip! is %-max-HP magic with a true-damage centre, so Sion's armour stack does nothing to it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Decimating Smash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Roar of the Slayer pokes from 800 and shreds your ARMOUR, not your MR — his chip is physical, so Doran's Shield and Second Wind hold it.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sion's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Drop Hallowed Mist as Decimating Smash releases: from outside the fog he cannot target you, and the charge is 6-10s of nothing.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Decimating Smash's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — every point of armour and health he stacks only feeds your snips.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sion carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You own the 1v1 forever. Respect only Unstoppable Onslaught at 60-140s and a five-man Decimating Smash in fights.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash: matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Sidestep it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sion Decimating Smash (6-10s): only stuns if fully charged — sidestep the wind-up. - Roar of the Slayer (8-12s): 800-range poke that cuts your ARMOUR, not your MR. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Sion with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Sion wastes Decimating Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Sion with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Decimating Smash releases early or whiffs — he has no stun for 6-10s, so commit the full pattern. Bad trade: standing in the charge arc so a full-hold knockup lands with your Mist still on cooldown.

edits.before: Sion wastes Decimating Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.

edits.before: That is Sion's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Roar of the Slayer shreds your armour, not your MR — that poke is physical.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.

edits.before: Track Sion's Decimating Smash (Stun): Charged = knockup. Sidestep it. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Decimating Smash stuns only when fully charged; Roar of the Slayer cuts armour, not MR, from 800 range.

edits.before: Sion can only really hurt you with a fully charged Q knockup, so never stand still in melee while he winds it up — sidestep the slow charge and a tap-cast Q is harmless. His E is long-range poke that slows and shreds your MR, but it can't out-damage what your passive healing restores once you trade back in melee. At level 1 you are both soft, so just farm; by level 3 your Q+E lets you snip a chunk of his big HP bar and E-reset out before his E poke connects.
edits.after: Sion can only really hurt you with a fully charged Decimating Smash (Q), so never stand still in melee while he winds it up — sidestep the slow charge and a tap-cast is harmless. Roar of the Slayer (E) pokes from 800 and shreds your armour, not your MR, so it cannot out-damage what A Thousand Cuts restores once you trade back in melee. At level 1 you are both soft, so just farm; by level 3 your Q+E snips a chunk of his big bar and resets out before his E returns.

edits.before: Pre-W you have no untargetability against his ranged E poke and he can shove — farm and wait for 6 rather than forcing.
edits.after: Roar of the Slayer shreds armour, not MR, so his 800-range chip is physical — farm through it and wait for 6 rather than forcing.

edits.before: Chip you with long-range E poke and its MR shred before you reach mist range, then shove and roam
edits.after: Chip you with Roar of the Slayer's 800-range armour shred before you reach mist range, then shove and roam

edits.after: Bait a fully charged Decimating Smash into Hallowed Mist so the swing whiffs and you punish the 6-10s gap

notes: Sion's Roar of the Slayer was described twice as shredding MAGIC RESIST; Riot's text says it reduces Armor. That flips the correct lane response (physical chip, so Doran's Shield/Second Wind) and was live on the page. None of Sion's abilities were named anywhere before this pass.
